description: Remove the active vote from one or more ve-tokens, claiming each stake's current pool fees immediately before its clearVote in one atomic batch. Use this instead of raw clearVote calldata: Ve33 discards pending voter fees when a stake's weight goes to zero, and a current_pool_key that is not the stake's active pool reverts the whole batch. Stake amount, lock end and NFT ownership are untouched; the stake stops directing emissions and earning that pool's voter fees. Prefer prepare_ve33_reallocation when votes move to other pools. See ekubo://docs/ve33-workflow.

chain_id.description: With ve_token, from get_ve33_allocations (STONX: 4663), not the wallet's chain

recipient.description: Fee recipient; defaults to sender for claimPoolFeesToSelf (address)

current_pool_key.description: The pool this stake currently votes for. Required: its fees are claimed immediately before the clear, and a key that is not the stake's active pool reverts the whole batch before anything is cleared. PoolKey {token0, token1, config} or {token0, token1, fee, tick_spacing, extension, stableswap_params?}, as read from the pool or vote

name: prepare_ve33_clear_vote
title: Prepare ve-token vote clearing
